title: Extend the released-control ceiling to fixed nonlinear monomial programs
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Extend #5160's fixed Clifford control ceiling to arbitrary nonlinear weighted monomial one-column controls with **fixed finite complete-product support independent of width**. For the released four-control endpoint, every sufficiently large width satisfying all four memberships has `t0_f=0`, excluding an all-width invertible family. Outer scalar owner coefficients may depend on width.

A finite generating alphabet alone is insufficient: weighted generators may have infinitely many projective products when word lengths vary with width. The rejected draft and review correction are retained unchanged. Growing product support, noncolumnwise routing, extra paid calls/axes, changed source/code/endpoint or compressed productive targets remain outside this theorem. No physical supplier, compiler transfer or κ claim follows from this primary theorem. A narrower standalone paid-control bound is separate below.

A separate immutable appendix records an exact one-H1 shear/inverse/raw-dual word and its direct 228-extra-H1 upper construction bill, which loses the inherited conditional allowance. Its separate `r >= 112` theorem covers only a **fresh standalone T with no initial nonfree observations**, translation-algebra free coefficients, commuting same-width X-Gaussian children and a FREE terminal E in the fixed finite monomial-Clifford endpoint class, at sufficiently large faithful widths. Under those exact premises 112 exceeds the conditional 44 allowance; this is **not a whole-caller amortized barrier**. Already-paid QY/native/IDLE/centre observations, nontranslation/noncommuting controls and paid E are outside. All allowed X maps commute with Q,D3, hence so does T. The wrapper authenticates this independently reviewed written appendix; it does not execute a new proof.

## Task and overlap

Task ID: `joint-query-controller`; scope status: **changed**. The changed premise is the FREE control alphabet: fixed Clifford controls are enlarged to arbitrary nonlinear weighted monomials while keeping finite complete-product support. This is the root-assigned support-partition extension of #5160 head `7800589ce99d932bdb063aafca1f501f1a38626d`, not another Clifford alphabet search. Scientific source is `4c0a359d88f22f05189d51f48387750b801a45d4`, `research/coded-native-caller`; #5126 context is `0e8a13c251a9be1029114cda8b4194f05f3a23ec`. Publication base is `ec2780e8aeb1c88acaf5e9e470ef8c68e7fbbb6c`. The sole all-author monitor checked complete created/updated PR pagination through 2026-10-23 12:32:52 UTC, cursor #5204, and rechecked canonical main at 12:33:54 UTC. Related #5200 is a different two-FULL/pure-2H17/dirty-identity-workspace monomial-Clifford stabilization theorem; this package addresses the four-control endpoint and nonlinear weighted monomials. These bounded checks are not a novelty guarantee. Existing held native/helper observations are not consumed.

The module preserves the exact reviewed proof `76bea47531ed557c0c9cb210c4324d6000c74415bf13e5747b7036567853f6ef`, independent written review `0b0fe1c33eea85ccd92a3423a705fd086c6f2669f1a47f37fba9c1ca4ae91973`, rejected first draft, minimal predecessor/source captures, and separate finite discriminator. No old package or shared code is changed. A distinct operator-valued paid-control appendix is included only after its separate independent PASS; no pending theorem or physical construction is promoted.

## Validation

```sh
python3 -I -W error -B research/nonlinear-monomial-control-ceiling/verify.py
python3 -I -O -W error -B research/nonlinear-monomial-control-ceiling/verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/nonlinear-monomial-control-ceiling --check-only
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/nonlinear-monomial-control-ceiling
python3 scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/nonlinear-monomial-control-ceiling --ref HEAD --check-source-history
```

Normal/O, registered replay, metadata/pins and committed-byte/source-history checks pass. Official export and fresh Git-free normal/O runs pass with unchanged exported bytes and complete byte-identical RESULT/MATRICES receipts. The wrapper preserves the 21 unchanged primary evidence files and 14 separate appendix captures and runs the unchanged author checker only in private scratch with its original four logical source paths. CRLF captures remain raw bytes.

The finite hook checks three exact 16×16 nonlinear weighted Toffoli/CCZ examples,108 terminal sandwiches, actual Gaussian inverses/squares, and meaningful dropped-hypothesis/transport-order controls. It does not prove the all-width theorem or reexecute actual112-owner/17-axis native source facts; those are explicitly inherited from the source-pinned predecessor. Written proof review supplies the uniform mathematical argument. No source/emitter/compiler/Lean or historical suite is run. Standard library, CPython 3.12, about 1 second per direct run. Hosted first run [39954453209](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39954453209) passed at contribution head `bddbdfab1cdba27ce69ce4a83d9c92a5d9e66bd8`, tested merge `7895eb79c` against base `ec2780e8aeb1c88acaf5e9e470ef8c68e7fbbb6c`: helper job `120416680974` ran 414 tests with 17 skips in 218.442 seconds; package job `120418712311` ran the declared normal/optimized finite hook and committed-input checks. Both emitted `PASS_PORTABLE_NONLINEAR_FINITE_SUPPORT_ONLY`, followed by registered-package and unchanged-byte success. This is finite-support verification, not a fresh native/compiler/all-width theorem replay.

Contribution head: `bddbdfab1cdba27ce69ce4a83d9c92a5d9e66bd8`.

Retain Dillon's released equations, Dugongue/mdumitrean source A/normalizers, Cinna Davis/1337isnot1337, Cao Yifan/intqwq, zxv, Jacob Alan Sussman, Ryanson Jonathan and the native/helper/Clifford/compiler lineage. Apache-2.0 and original notices preserved. No published-paper novelty, independent human acceptance or proof-kernel verification is claimed.

## Open next questions

Specify one actual control with growing complete-product support, noncolumnwise action, affordable paid work or changed observation/endpoint, with exact input ownership, source access, inverse and complete bill. The theorem neither supplies nor excludes that changed contract. Native/helper-observation work stays with its existing investigators; unknown finite costs/reserves are not zero.
